intelligence.essence: You don't join NayaNET. You answer ten questions, and a world appears — your world. Onboarding creates the world, creates the content for the world, and makes it personal: your business, what you're into, who you are. Every other platform hands you an empty room and says "fill it." This one hands you a world that's already yours and says "welcome home." Personal isn't a feature — it's the foundation.
